Mission Local reported that, after a two-and-a-half-year process, the State Bar sent DA Brooke Jenkins to a diversionary program. The bar said the ethics complaints would be “best resolved” by requiring her to participate. Mission Local also reported that the bar declined to pursue the other complaints, while treating her improper access to and sharing of Troy McAlister’s confidential rap sheet as the misconduct addressed by the program.
